long_biography.plain_text:
An approach from IKEA turned the heavy-textile sewing capacity Bogdan Kaczmarek had developed for clothing into a new manufacturing platform. Working from the Kalisz area, he began producing sofa seats and mattresses, then built a large-scale furniture operation around reliable delivery and the retailer's production standards.

Kaczmarek's earlier venture with Wiesław Kostera imported foreign clothing before developing Big Star jeans production. That experience supplied machinery, logistics and international-client discipline when furniture manufacturing emerged as the larger opportunity. He has since extended the group upstream, joining Innova Capital to acquire Polish wood-panel plants. The transaction added engineered materials to businesses already making furniture, mattresses, textiles and components.
